source: v4b analytic implementation, original S4 and v3 preserved; no new code Git revision claimed

split.calibration: t<30s; LOS and Full pooled once, no duplication over gyro bias
split.evaluation: t>=40s; previously examined historical data, NOT blind independent validation

model: sigma_psi(g)=clip(exp(a+b*log((clip(g,train_min,train_max)+offset)/reference)),0.05deg,180deg), g=abs(ds/dpsi); calibrated constant uniform outlier probability
training: all inverse angle candidates at calibration GT XY; mixture likelihood evaluated at calibration GT heading; no nearest-truth branch selection in fit or runtime
fit: 3 calibration-only starts 5/15/45deg; b [-2,0]; a bounds0.05..90deg; outlier logit[-14,14]; support>=30; choose minimum calibration NLL only
controls: original simulated controls regenerated by frozen builder using source truth; not new estimator truth observations
runtime: predicted component XY; sigma frozen at predicted inverse branch and propagated geometry uncertainty; all angle candidates + uniform prior-preserving branch
changes: replace arbitrary six sigma candidates and70%prior/IMM with calibrated heteroscedastic sigma and learned uniform outlier component; bundled change, not isolated sigma-only causal attribution
fixed: same initial state/P, motion model, original S4 causal acceptance mask, inverse LUT, analytic wrapped update and mode reducer
checks: calibration suffix poison invariance; linear angular Gaussian; antipodal+close modes; S4 parity; all evaluation rows recomputed; mode tol1e-8/200 vs1e-10/400 with same .02deg/.005m/2% thresholds
limits: single route/seed; temporal correlation not explicitly modeled; calibration GT XY vs runtime uncertain XY; pseudo angle likelihood not exact s change of variables; no automatic adoption
